test_stages.scope: Exercise local-to-GitHub mapping, redaction, idempotent reconciliation, and retry-marker behavior with a trusted least-privilege connection.
test_stages.pass_condition: First-milestone local IDs map one-to-one to remote counterparts; a simulated sync failure preserves local authority and records a retry marker.

test_stages.scope: Run Spring Boot tests against PostgreSQL/Flyway for registration, simulated verification/reset adapters, sign-in/sign-out, session and CSRF protection, password hashing, role separation, anonymous access, unverified customer denial, and cross-account denial.
test_stages.pass_condition: All first-milestone backend acceptance criteria pass against the exact backend candidate, including failure paths and stored/logged value checks.

test_stages.scope: Run component and integration tests for role-bound navigation, account flows, English/German browser fallback and visible switching, current-device persistence, submitted-language labels, and absence of prohibited simulated inbox/messaging/refund surfaces.
test_stages.pass_condition: Frontend tests pass at the exact frontend candidate and match the accepted API and flow contracts.

test_stages.scope: Start PostgreSQL, API, and React client; exercise anonymous browsing, separate customer/provider registration, simulated provider verification, sign-in/sign-out, role-bound navigation, language switching, and rejected anonymous/unverified/cross-role mutations at 390px and 1280px.
test_stages.pass_condition: The proposed milestone demonstration succeeds with synthetic data and no horizontal overflow, inaccessible primary control, missing label, or unidentified input error.

test_stages.scope: Trace accepted specification and plan snapshots, exact candidate identity, Code Review, Build Verification, Quality Review, blocker resolution, and final human review boundary.
test_stages.pass_condition: Every claim is digest-bound, every required role is independent, all findings are dispositioned by the Orchestrator, and no later milestone or deployment is authorized.

blocker: Tracking contract tests cannot be executed until the GitHub capability and least-privilege access are trusted; all execution also waits for passing readiness and approved instance envelopes.
